description:
Get a card pay link that adds money to your wallet. Nothing is added until the link is paid.
Use for: topping up before you fund a bounty or send money. Hand `payUrl` to the person who pays.
Not for: checking your balance (get_wallet); paying for a draft bounty (fund_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: fund_wallet({"amount":{"amount":5000,"currency":"usd"}})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: account_setup_required, funding_unavailable; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

amount.description: How much to add, from $1 to $10,000.

name: fund_wallet

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working. Left out: no set time.

machinePayment.description: Alternative to payUrl for the same deposit. Send body as JSON to url using method before expiresAt. Choose one payment method. Left out unless enabled for this account.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

payUrl.description: Open this and pay by card. The money is added to your wallet once the payment goes through.

title: Add money to your wallet
